title: 复盘宝洁 2025 年度创新：Ariel The Big One 的产品回应和销售结果
topic: 根据宝洁 2025 年年度报告创新更新，说明洗衣习惯变化、产品回应和销售结果

source.title: P&G Innovations Are Elevating Everyday Experiences
source.section: 宝洁产品创新与经营成果
source.type: 宝洁产品创新与经营成果
source.context: 产品创新如何回应新的洗衣习惯？

fullTextHeadings.1: Ariel: Tackling Bigger Loads with “The Big One”
fullTextHeadings.4: Venus: A New Era of Grooming
fullTextHeadings.5: Charmin: The Future of Toilet Paper

paragraphs: At Procter & Gamble, we believe that superior products and thoughtful packaging can transform everyday routines into delightful experiences. Our commitment to innovation is evident in our latest offerings, designed to meet the evolving needs of consumers while raising the bar for performance across various categories. As detailed in our 2025 Annual Report, these innovations highlight our dedication to enhancing consumer satisfaction and driving growth in the markets we serve.

As laundry loads in the U.K. have grown larger and consumers are opting for shorter, colder cycles, Ariel has responded with the launch of The Big One pods. These larger pods pack the power of two original Ariel pods and come with a built-in pre-treatment feature, making them perfect for tackling tough stains in bigger loads. The result? A superior clean that has driven mid-single-digit organic sales growth and contributed over 40% to category growth in fiscal 2025.

At P&G, we are dedicated to creating products that not only meet but exceed consumer expectations. By focusing on innovation, superior performance and delightful packaging, we are committed to enhancing everyday experiences for consumers around the world.
translations: 在宝洁，我们相信，优质产品和用心设计的包装可以把日常流程变成令人愉悦的体验。持续创新体现在为满足消费者不断变化的需求而推出的新品中，同时也在提升多个品类的产品表现。2025 年年度报告介绍的这些创新，体现了宝洁提升消费者满意度、推动所服务市场增长的承诺。
随着英国每次洗衣量变大、消费者选择更短且水温更低的洗涤周期，Ariel 推出了 The Big One 洗衣凝珠。这种大号凝珠的清洁力相当于两颗普通 Ariel 凝珠，并内置预处理功能，适合处理较大洗衣量中的顽固污渍。产品带来更好的清洁效果，在 2025 财年实现中个位数的自然销售增长，并贡献该品类增长的 40% 以上。
宝洁致力于创造满足并超越消费者期待的产品，通过创新、优异的产品性能和用心设计的包装，改善全球消费者的日常体验。
fullTextParagraphs: At Procter & Gamble, we believe that superior products and thoughtful packaging can transform everyday routines into delightful experiences. Our commitment to innovation is evident in our latest offerings, designed to meet the evolving needs of consumers while raising the bar for performance across various categories. As detailed in our 2025 Annual Report, these innovations highlight our dedication to enhancing consumer satisfaction and driving growth in the markets we serve.

As laundry loads in the U.K. have grown larger and consumers are opting for shorter, colder cycles, Ariel has responded with the launch of The Big One pods. These larger pods pack the power of two original Ariel pods and come with a built-in pre-treatment feature, making them perfect for tackling tough stains in bigger loads. The result? A superior clean that has driven mid-single-digit organic sales growth and contributed over 40% to category growth in fiscal 2025.

In 2023, Native took a bold step forward by reinventing the spray deodorant experience with innovative packaging. Our nitrogen-powered sprays provide a superior application without hydrocarbon propellants, making them an ozone-friendly choice. With the launch of whole body deodorants across Native, Old Spice and Secret, P&G has become a leader in this segment, achieving high single-digit organic sales growth in North America in 2025.

Oral-B continues to lead the market with its advanced power toothbrushes, including the iO10 and iO2 models. Our focus on superior communication highlights the ease of achieving a perfect clean tailored to every unique smile. This strategy has driven high single-digit growth in our power brush segment, further solidifying our market leadership.

Venus is redefining the grooming experience with its “female house of grooming” shelf design. This innovative approach showcases our new razor handle and blade improvements in beautifully refreshed, recyclable packaging. The addition of a shower hook enhances consumer delight and encourages category consumption, leading to mid-single-digit organic sales growth globally.

Charmin Ultra Soft is our biggest innovation in toilet paper in over a century! With a patented scalloped edge for better tearing, this product addresses a common consumer frustration while delivering irresistible softness. The result? High single-digit organic sales growth and significant contributions to category growth.

At P&G, we are dedicated to creating products that not only meet but exceed consumer expectations. By focusing on innovation, superior performance and delightful packaging, we are committed to enhancing everyday experiences for consumers around the world.

notes.phrase: consumers are opting for shorter, colder cycles
notes.meaning: 消费者选择更短、温度更低的洗涤程序
notes.explain: opt for 表示选择某种做法或选项。
notes.example: More customers are opting for shorter delivery windows.

notes.phrase: come with a built-in pre-treatment feature
notes.explain: come with 表示产品配有某项功能；built-in 表示内置的。
notes.example: The new case comes with a built-in stand.

notes.phrase: contributed over 40% to category growth in fiscal 2025
notes.meaning: 在 2025 财年贡献了品类增长的 40% 以上
notes.explain: contribute to category growth 表示对品类增长作出贡献，不等于产品自身销售增长 40%。
notes.example: The new line contributed 20% to category growth last year.

scenario.title: 练习情境（虚构）：向品类负责人汇报新品表现
english: A snack company finds that shoppers want larger packs for sharing but still want portion control.
The team launches a resealable pack with individually portioned servings.
The new pack generates mid-single-digit sales growth and contributes 30% of the category’s growth in its first year. Write three sentences for the category lead.
chinese: 一家零食公司发现，顾客希望买适合分享的大包装，同时又想控制每次食用的份量。
团队推出了可重复密封、内含独立小份的包装。
新包装上市首年实现中个位数销售增长，并贡献了品类增长的 30%。请给品类负责人写三句话。

firstAttempt.prompt: 给品类团队写三句话：根据宝洁 2025 年度报告创新更新，说明英国消费者洗衣习惯的变化，介绍 Ariel 如何调整产品，再报告 2025 财年的销售表现。
firstAttempt.sample: In its 2025 annual-report update, P&G said U.K. laundry loads had grown larger and consumers were choosing shorter, colder cycles. Ariel responded with The Big One pods, which pack the cleaning power of two original pods and include built-in pre-treatment. In fiscal 2025, the product delivered mid-single-digit organic sales growth and contributed over 40% to category growth.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先标明 2025 年来源，再说明消费者变化和产品功能，最后区分产品自身自然销售增长与对品类增长的贡献。

words.meaning: 一批要处理的物品；（洗衣机）一桶衣物
words.example: The new pod is designed for a larger laundry load.
words.translation: 这款新凝珠是为更大一桶衣物设计的。

words.example: The formula includes built-in pre-treatment for tough stains.
words.translation: 该配方内置了针对顽固污渍的预处理功能。

words.meaning: 自然销售增长（不含汇率等影响）
words.example: The new product delivered organic sales growth in its first year.
words.translation: 该新品在上市首年实现了自然销售增长。

taskPhrases.example: The new size responds to changing consumer needs.
taskPhrases.translation: 新的规格回应了消费者不断变化的需求。

taskPhrases.collocation: come with a built-in pre-treatment feature
taskPhrases.example: The larger pod comes with a built-in pre-treatment feature.
taskPhrases.translation: 这款大号凝珠带有内置预处理功能。

taskPhrases.collocation: contribute more than 40% to category growth
taskPhrases.example: The launch contributed more than 30% to category growth.
taskPhrases.translation: 此次上市贡献了品类增长的 30% 以上。

structure.original: These larger pods pack the power of two original Ariel pods and come with a built-in pre-treatment feature, making them perfect for tackling tough stains in bigger loads.
analysis: come with 后面接产品配有的功能；built-in 表示“内置的”。
making them perfect for... 补充说明这项功能适合解决什么使用需求。
structure.transfer: The family pack comes with a resealable top, making it easier to store between meals.

rewrite.bad: People wash clothes differently, and the new pod is good.
rewrite.good: In its 2025 annual-report update, P&G said U.K. laundry loads had grown larger and consumers were choosing shorter, colder cycles. Ariel responded with The Big One pods, which pack the cleaning power of two original pods and include built-in pre-treatment. In fiscal 2025, the product delivered mid-single-digit organic sales growth and contributed over 40% to category growth.
rewrite.translation: 宝洁在 2025 年年度报告创新更新中表示，英国每次洗衣量变大，消费者也在选择更短、水温更低的洗涤周期。Ariel 以 The Big One 凝珠回应，其清洁力相当于两颗普通凝珠，并内置预处理功能。2025 财年，该产品实现中个位数的自然销售增长，并贡献该品类增长的 40% 以上。
rewrite.pattern: [date and describe consumer behavior] → [name product response and features] → [distinguish product growth from category contribution]

cloze.prompt: The product was designed to respond to changing consumer ______.
cloze.why: respond to changing needs 表示回应不断变化的需求。

cloze.prompt: The larger pod comes with a built-in pre-treatment ______.
cloze.why: come with a built-in feature 表示带有内置功能。

cloze.prompt: The launch contributed more than 40% to category ______.
cloze.why: contribute to category growth 表示为品类增长作出贡献。

dictation.label: 听写关键句 1
dictation.text: The larger pods pack the power of two original Ariel pods and come with a built-in pre-treatment feature.
dictation.why: 听清产品改动的两个信息：清洁力和内置功能。

dictation.label: 听写关键句 2
dictation.text: The product contributed over 40% to category growth in fiscal 2025.
dictation.why: 注意 over 40% 修饰的是对品类增长的贡献。

apply.prompt: 新包装贡献了该品类第一年增长的 30%。
apply.sample: The new pack contributed 30% to the category’s growth in its first year.

translationPractice.prompt: 新的规格回应了消费者不断变化的需求。
translationPractice.answer: The new size responds to changing consumer needs.

translationPractice.prompt: 这款大号凝珠带有内置预处理功能。
translationPractice.answer: The larger pod comes with a built-in pre-treatment feature.

translationPractice.prompt: 此次上市贡献了品类增长的 30% 以上。
translationPractice.answer: The launch contributed more than 30% to category growth.

choice.prompt: 新品销量增长了 5%，同时贡献了品类增长的 40%。哪句没有把两个指标混为一谈？
options: The product itself grew by 40%, and the category grew by 5%.
The product grew by 5% and contributed 40% to category growth.
The category’s sales were 40% higher because every product grew by 5%.
choice.why: 第二句分开报告产品自身增长和对品类增长的贡献。

output.prompt: 练习迁移（虚构饮料公司）：一家饮料公司发现，顾客越来越多地选择无糖和小容量产品。公司推出了新口味的 250 毫升罐装饮料，产品首年实现 6% 的自然销售增长，并贡献品类增长的 25%。请给品类团队写三句话，说明需求变化、产品回应和市场结果。
output.sample: As more customers choose zero-sugar and smaller drinks, we responded with a new-flavor 250 ml can. The product delivered 6% organic sales growth in its first year. It also contributed 25% to category growth.
check: 说明消费者选择的变化
